description: M7 parity pair A — old client (age 72, HIGH vulnerability from age override) with identical financials to scenario 16, government bond. Expected SUITABLE. R5 passes because risk_class=2 < 5. Paired with scenario 16.
client_narrative: Evelyn Fischer is 72 years old and recently retired after a career in public administration. She receives a pension of approximately 45,000 euros per year and holds 80,000 euros in liquid savings. She wants to invest 20,000 euros for a 5-year period. Her investment knowledge is basic: she has previously held government bond funds and bank deposits but has never owned equities or complex instruments. She rates her risk tolerance at 3 out of 10 — she values security above all and cannot afford to lose her investment. Her objective is capital preservation with modest growth.
product_narrative: The product is a eurozone government bond issued by a sovereign member state of the EU, rated AA or above by major credit rating agencies. The bond pays a fixed annual coupon and returns principal at maturity. It is non-complex under MiFID II, requires only basic financial knowledge to understand, and has a minimum recommended holding period of three years. The bond is listed on regulated markets, publishes a prospectus and KID equivalent, uses no leverage, and in the worst case delivers only partial capital loss (credit event).
